The printed menu is set on khaki/beige stock with a thin bracket-framed "RANCHO CANTINA" serif wordmark in black, gold-tan section headings (ANTOJITOS, WOOD FIRED, MARGARITA TIME), small crown ornaments, and vintage line-art illustrations of a vaquero on horseback, a covered wagon, a whole fish, a cowboy hat and a skillet. The Danville storefront was repainted in a medium tan body with a burnt-orange secondary and off-white trim (Bay Area Telegraph). Overall mood: rustic old-California ranch / Californio heritage rather than bright cantina kitsch.
